・Deliver 4 LATAM TownHalls (two in August, two in September)
・Deliver 4 Twitter Spaces (two in August, two in September)
・Latam Fund10 Ideafest, delivered
・Translation of Catalyst materials to Spanish and Portuguese onboard projects and reviewers during the TownHalls and Spaces made during this two months.

Please find in the link below our full report on the POA for Milestone 2

ms.report:
Dear Reviewers, please find below all the proper evidence of our Milestone 3 completion.
In the following PDF report you will find all the evidence and links, together with all the visual pieces we have created.
The report is located here: MILESTONE #3_FINAL.pdf
Below you can find a quick summary of what we have achieved within this Milestone.
Deliver 4 Latam Townhalls and 4 Twitter Spaces
5 TownHalls and 4 Twitter Spaces were delivered during the considered period. Below you will find the detail.
DECEMBER 2024
2 TownHalls delivered: December 14th and December 28th
2 Twitter Spaces delivered: December 9th and December 23th
JANUARY 2024 (Normal Holiday season in Latam)
1 TownHall delivered: January 25th
FEBRUARY 2024 
2 TownHalls delivered: February 8th and February 22th
2 Twitter Spaces delivered: February 3rd and February 17th
Create at least 3 governance actions within the LATAM Cardano Community Governance Site.
During March we have completed the 3 required governance actions, and to properly show them we have decided to use screenshots of the Summon platform where the actions were executed and where the Community has its multisig wallet. The corresponding screenshots, along with the link to the TxID can be found in the Milestone main report. 
Governance video explanation: https://www.loom.com/share/ae1818a3b05347c79c0b206723b53584
Continue with the contribution of the Cardano Voltaire era Roadmap
For the LATAM participation at the Voltaire Roadmap, we have participated in the Intersect's Civic Committee, Lead the Cardano Constitution ratification Working Group, during February and March we engaged in a Cardano's backlog process feedback and design workshop at London, and we have created a visual on the need to balance the Technical Protocol of the Blockchain with the Human protocol needed for proper decentralized governance, resulting in a draft paper, that is being write with that idea.
